title: Landmark ASEAN digital pact will guide region on AI, digital economy: Marcos
key_facts: Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr spoke on 8 Oct 2026 at the Forbes Global CEO Conference in Singapore.
He said the ASEAN Digital Economy Framework Agreement (DEFA) is to be signed at the 49th ASEAN Summit in November and will give countries a roadmap, including on AI.
The Philippines chairs ASEAN this year; DEFA negotiations concluded in May; DEFA was first announced in 2023.
DEFA sets common rules for digital trade, supports trusted cross-border data flows, digital payments and online consumer protection, per CNA.
Marcos said that when he took over the chair the bloc 'was not talking about AI enough' and floated an AI idea modelled on the ASEAN Power Grid.
He said ASEAN and China are making 'good progress' on a South China Sea code of conduct but gave no details; he voiced concern that a mistake on the ground could go out of control.
On tariffs he said the Philippines would 'deal with whatever comes down the pike'; the US imposed a 12.5 percent tariff on Philippine exports in July.
quote_evidence: The signing of a landmark regional digital economy agreement at the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit in November will allow for a roadmap for different countries to abide by, especially in sectors such as artificial intelligence (AI), said Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr on Thursday (Oct 8).
negotiations for the ASEAN Digital Economy Framework Agreement (DEFA) concluded in May.
Marcos said that when the Philippines took over the ASEAN chairmanship, he noticed the bloc "was not talking about AI enough".
why_it_matters_hint: A regional rulebook for digital trade and AI is due to be signed in November.
notes: Statement by Marcos at a public dialogue, reported by CNA; signing is planned, not done. DEFA text itself not read.
